title: Automated Weekly Marketing Data Sync from Webinars, Email and Social
summary: n8n workflows that pull webinar, email, Facebook and LinkedIn metrics into one database every week, with no manual reporting.
headline: Marketing reports that build themselves
problem: Marketing metrics lived in four different platforms and were collected by hand.
solution: I built scheduled n8n workflows that call the WebinarJam, GoHighLevel, Facebook Graph and LinkedIn APIs, create or update the matching rows in Supabase, and keep everything current without anyone touching it.
highlights: Webinar registrants and attendance from WebinarJam
Post metrics from the Facebook Graph and LinkedIn APIs
Create-or-update logic so reruns never duplicate data
role: Sole engineer. I designed the data model and built every sync workflow.

results.label: Marketing data collected automatically every week
Consistent, up-to-date numbers across all channels
